after.Question: Should Party A be assigned a round-1 exit by inference from its later absence from the narrative, or should its exit remain unidentified within the anonymous cohorts?
after.Recommended answer: Retain unidentified exit membership in the source ledger. Ask Alex whether the narration-based round-1 inference should be an explicit research assumption; it does not identify whether Party A failed to bid or was one of the two low bidders.
after.Why, with page: Pp. 28-30 establish Party A's NDA but do not name the nine IOI bidders, two low bidders or strategic round-2 non-submitter. Alex's voice note P22 favors round 1; reference row 6042 places Party A's dropout July 22, creating a research-interpretation conflict.
after.What changes if answered differently: A round-1 identity assumption excludes Party A from #32 but still leaves its round-1 exit mechanism unresolved. Any named exit must be removed from its cohort to avoid double counting; total participation does not increase.
